## Notes

Polys Entertainment (Polyphony Digital from 1998), Sony; PlayStation, Japan 1997-12-23; license tests gate Simulation mode events; credits buy cars, parts, tuning; 140 cars, 11 tracks; first DualShock-designed game; 10.85 million sold; IGN: grandfather of modern console racing sims.
